props.label: Serial Number
props.description: A unique number identifying this inventory - maybe a Lot or Serial. This will be used to set the Id field - using a system trigger.

props.label: Expires At
props.description: expiration date - determined by the shelf life days on the product in fuuz - this is based upon the receipt date typically - although, you can manually set this value in the system as well.

props.label: Product
props.description: product code- optional - as there maybe times when the product is not setup in Fuuz yet - in those cases, set the extProduct field instead of this one.
